lines.t: I came with dust upon my hands
A heart undone by who I'd been
I could not lift my tired eyes
I thought your holiness would say goodbye
The room was still, the night was white
And all my shame was laid beside
My trembling knees upon the floor
I had no words to ask for more
Then through the silence, soft as rain
I felt a touch that knew my name
Your hands were resting on my shoulders
Like mercy finding every scar
I looked up into living fire and saw the kindness of your heart
Your eyes were shining past forever
Your smile was warmer than the dawn
And all the love inside my broken chest broke open
When you called me yours
No crowd around, no world to see
Just you, my king, trembling me
The air was full of holy light
Like every shadow lost its fight
I thought you'd turn from what I'd done
But love came near like a rising sun
You didn't speak of all my stains
You held my heart inside your grace.
Your hands were resting on my shoulders like mercy finding.
Every scar I looked up into living fire and saw the kindness of your heart.
Your eyes were shining past forever.
Your smile was warmer than the dawn
And all the love inside my broken chest broke open
When you called me yours
Bright and king, alone in grace
No veil of fear before your face
You saw the girl I tried to hide
And still you drew my heart to life
Not because I was clean enough
But because your love is stronger than the darkest thing I carried in
You made a home beneath my skin
Your hands were resting on my shoulders like mercy finding every scar
I looked up into living fire and saw the kindness of your heart
Your eyes were shining past forever
Your smile was warmer than the dawn
And all the love inside my broken chest broke open
When you called me yours
My king
My love, you saw me and called me yours
